purpose: Define a known-good machine-readable baseline for Contract Format 1.4 validation so subsequent tree or validator changes expose semantic regressions rather than silently changing expected behavior.

topics.name: Validation Regression Baseline
topics.purpose: Define a known-good machine-readable baseline for Contract Format 1.4 validation so subsequent tree or validator changes expose semantic regressions rather than silently changing expected behavior.

semantics.comparison_rule: Candidate validation results are compared against an explicit compatible baseline.
semantics.no_freeze_rule: Baseline does not freeze legitimate semantic evolution; intentional changes update baseline through explicit review.
semantics.regression_rule: Unexpected new errors/fatals, lost required coverage or changed expected fixture behavior are regressions.
semantics.improvement_rule: Resolved findings may be accepted as improvements and update the baseline explicitly.
semantics.validator_rule: Validator-version changes may require controlled baseline regeneration rather than silent result drift.
semantics.provenance_rule: Baseline update records previous baseline and review evidence.

invariants.rule: Validation outcomes, findings, exceptions, evidence, baselines and release decisions are explicit machine-readable facts and never silently rewrite source semantics.

hard_gates.condition: baseline updated automatically to make failing candidate pass
validator change rewrites baseline without review
lost coverage treated as harmless result drift

references.purpose: Regression baseline includes golden fixture expectations.
Baseline anchors an accepted evidence snapshot.
